standard-dialogue-before-talking-to-rupe.npc: Oh, hello there. I'm afraid I don't have time to talk right now. I'm rather busy. Come back some other time please.

standard-dialogue-after-talking-to-ruper.npc: Who am I? Why, how impertinent! I am a princess and I will be spoken to like one. Now be off with you. I have no time for scruffy adventurers like yourself!

standard-dialogue-after-talking-to-ruper.player: I notice there is a dwarf up in the tower there. Why is he up there?

standard-dialogue-after-talking-to-ruper.npc: I do believe that is none of your business, young scallyrumpit! Now kindly leave.

standard-dialogue-after-completion-of-gr.npc: Thanks again for finding my pendant. I felt so lost without it.
